description: This file is a shell script that performs tests related to a version control system (git). It defines test cases involving file modifications, commits, and diff outputs, utilizing external scripts and commands to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_set_editor
methods.description: Sets a custom editor script for git operations.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific status code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
